name: Rashida Tlaib

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "The Supreme Court’s dangerous reversal of #Roe turns back the clock nearly 50 years, and jeopardizes the health, well-being, and autonomy of women and those who can get pregnant nationwide. Congress can and must ensure the right to #AbortionAccess by passing #WHPA today"
Rated 100% by Naral Pro-Choice America in 2021

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "End qualified immunity."
"We must dismantle our nation’s racist policing system, end qualified immunity, and invest in the basic needs of our communities to build lasting public safety."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Rashida is one of the few Congresspeople who consistently votes NO to the annual National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), because she can’t justify Congress continually rubber stamping annual increases to our bloated military budget—especially while our own communities are struggling to get by. Because the NDAA does pass every year, Rashida does consistently secure amendments to the bill to support veterans and servicemembers."

"This record-breaking $858 billion so-called defense budget is impossible to justify when our neighbors are struggling to put food on the table, fighting to keep a roof over their heads, and rationing their medication. I voted NO."
In order to balance the budget, do you support reducing defense spending? "Yes"
Voted against HR 7900 "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023"

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Co-sponsored the Medicare For All Act of 2021 (and previous versions), and co-led a virtual rally to unveil the legislation."

"Our profit-driven health care system is killing us. In the richest country in the history of the world, no one should have to die because they are unable to afford the care they need. We need #MedicareForAll."

"The Affordable Care Act was signed into law 14 years ago today, bringing affordable health care to millions of families. Health care is a human right. Now we need to go further and pass Medicare for All."
Voted in favor of HR 1425 "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Enhancement Act" in 2020

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

"I hosted a Special Order Hour in honor of Mother’s Day. Congress must do more to uplift our mothers and their families. From ending child poverty to paid leave for all, childcare, Black maternal health, and reproductive freedom, we need to center mothers in our policies."

"Mothers of color face unjust maternal and infant health disparities along with economic disparities, and are leaders in the fight for reproductive justice and policies such as affordable childcare and paid leave."
Voted in favor of HR 6201 "Families First Coronavirus Response Act" in 2020
